notes.title: Patch Notes for April 9, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Corrected the issue where lights would turn off at a distance on medium quality settings.
[*] Addressed the problem of stains disappearing when hovered over.
[*] Rendering issues on ultra settings have been fixed.
[*] Mouse sensitivity instability has been resolved.
[*] The method for detecting optimal resolutions has been refined.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for February 27, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The breakroom door no longer remains open in the basement
[*] Lipstick can still be opened after inspecting it and exiting immediately.
[*] Fixed the vent puzzle issue that occurred when exiting the special inspection while adjusting.
[*] Local dialogue and eavesdropped subtitles now display correctly.
[*] The pendulum now moves in the basement.
[*] The tutorial no longer remains on screen after loading a save.
[*] It's now possible to scroll through progression entries after switching between them.
[*] 4K displays now automatically adjust screen percentage for enhanced performance.
[*] Blood trails no longer persist after loading a game.
[*] The highlight on the typewriter case is removed upon opening.
[*] Sophie now only says "You need a screwdriver" if you interact with the screws.
[*] The bench in the basement is no longer accessible for walking on.
[*] The laundry bag's interaction point is now correctly positioned.
[*] The highlight for the deciphering puzzle has been made more visible.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for December 20, 2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that caused the second phone call in room 505 to trigger too early
[*] Fixed bug that caused an acolyte ""ghost"" to appear when reloading a save
[*] Fixed bug that caused Bernard to have his ""exasperated"" idle in inappropriate moments
[*] Fixed bug that caused the vent puzzle to be blocked on the gamepad
[*] Fixed bug that caused the Texas letter to reappear after throwing it away
[*] Fixed bug that caused the player to get stuck in the elevator in the lobby after loading a save
[*] Fixed bug that caused lights to be off when loading a save from another part of the game during the power outage
[*] Fixed room 509 phone cord physics
[*] Fixed camera glitch at the end of the last phone call with Andrew
[*] Added the ability to put back the ice pick and the tip
[*] Changed fuse box behavior so it no longer automatically removes the ice pick from inventory
[*] Added "Saving..." UI when auto-saving
[*] Fixed various lighting bugs
[/list]

[*] Added back up saves
[*] Various clipping fixes

[*] Adjusted start position and camera distance for various objects in inspection mode
[*] Adjusted opacity of god rays in room 509
[*] Fixed some problems with highlights on menu buttons

[*] Removed Syracuse thought on game score sheet in the break room
[*] Fixed bug with toggle text for open newspaper in the break room
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for November 7, 2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed various localization issues.
[*] Fixed collision and clipping issues.
[*] Fixed display mode issues in the Initial Settings menu.
[*] Fixed cursor offset issue that occurred with some screen resolutions.
[*] Added the dog in the family picture in 507.
[*] Fixed condition problem that prevented the "Live To Fix Another Day" achievement from triggering.
[*] Ensured that clue selection is not possible on Candle Stash Plan until you’ve found the Candle Stash Note.
[*] Increased the interaction zone for the candle in the laundry room.
[*] Removed “Leslie Boswell” mistake from Sophie’s journal entry about the Adam or Eve pulp fiction.
[*] Fixed bug with the saving and loading of the blood footsteps.
[*] Fixed missing facts that led to Maurice talking about Paul first even though Beth was the acolyte.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for November 3rd, 2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added more supported resolutions.
[*] Fixed various localization issues.
[*] Fixed various asset issues.
[*] Removed the ability for the 0 on the numpad to trigger the game's ending.
[*] Blocked all input during the Consequences Warning.
[*] Prevented the "Game completed" achievement from triggering when talking about the chocolate shoe to Andrew.
[*] Ensured both Eugene achievements don't trigger simultaneously.
[*] Updated the hint after opening the chest in 507 so Sophie always suggests calling the acolyte for help.
[*] Made letters in the typewriter case non-throwable until they've been read.
[*] Fixed the uninteractable 509 safe bug that occurred after looking at the code.
[*] Adjusted Sophie's dialogue about Bernard at the end of the game.
[*] Fixed some journal entries.
[*] Added the ability to exit the credits by pressing the pause button
[*] Improved the physics of the telephone cord.
[/list]
